guides.title: 相位移光罩工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Phase-shift mask engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光」建立判讀邊界。相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane to define the interpretation boundary. Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光：相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜對密集與孤立線比較成像對比：一種相位配置不會同等改善所有圖形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查：設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane: Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: One phase scheme does not improve every pattern equally. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review phase assignment and imaging window together: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「對密集與孤立線比較成像對比」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review phase assignment and imaging window together to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只需把兩束光強相加。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「最佳焦點改善代表所有焦距都改善。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Simply add the two intensities.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Better best-focus imaging proves improvement at every focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 相位移光罩工程涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Phase-shift mask engineering involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.
